# Custom App Payload Samples

## 01 - 5px （对齐）

```json
{
  "text": [
    {
      "content": "A0123456789a",
      "fontHeight": 5,
      "align": "center",
      "valign": "middle",
      "rect": [0, 0, 52, 16],
      "charSpacing": 1,
      "color": "#FFFFFF"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 02 - 10px（指定x，y）

```json
{
  "text": [
    {
      "content": "t-1 AT",
      "fontHeight": 10,
      "x": 5,
      "y": 3,
      "rect": [0, 0, 52, 16],
      "charSpacing": 1,
      "color": "#00FF88"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 03 - 对齐

```json
{
  "text": [
    {"content": "L", "fontHeight": 5, "align": "left", "valign": "top", "rect": [0, 0, 17, 16], "color": "#FF0000"},
    {"content": "C", "fontHeight": 5, "align": "center", "valign": "middle", "rect": [17, 0, 18, 16], "color": "#00FF00"},
    {"content": "R", "fontHeight": 5, "align": "right", "valign": "bottom", "rect": [35, 0, 17, 16], "color": "#0000FF"}
  ]
}
```

## 04 - image

```json
{
  "image": [
    {
      "data": "data:image/gif;base64,",
      "position": [3, 4]
    },
    {
      "data": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAUAAAACCAYAAACQahZdAAAAE0lEQVR4AWL6fy7lPzpmYsACAAAAAP//cv14NAAAAAZJREFUAwD3yA/1eCCY1AAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==",

    }
  ]
}
```

## 13 - 组合

```json
{
  "image": [
    {
      "data": "data:image/gif;base64,",
      "position": [
        0,
        0
      ]
    }
  ],
  "text": [
    {
      "content": "25C",
      "fontHeight": 10,
      "x": 10,
      "y": 0,
      "color": "#FFFFFF"
    },
    {
      "content": "Sunny",
      "fontHeight": 5,
      "x": 28,
      "y": 10,
      "color": "#C8C8C8"
    }
  ]
}
```
